topics.label: Introduction to the Hallmarks of Cancer and Progression Model
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning outcomes, the multi-step progression model, and the conceptual framework of the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Evasion of Growth Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular signaling cascades and mutations that drive sustained cell proliferation and resistance to growth-inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells evade terminal maturation by undergoing a differentiation block in hematopoietic and epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how mutations affecting p53 and apoptotic regulators allow cancer cells to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor cells bypass the Hayflick limit via telomerase reactivation and overcome normal senescence stress pathways.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the biochemical mechanisms, metabolic rewiring, and oncometabolite signaling that support cancer cell growth.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how tumors stimulate and regulate new blood vessel formation to supply oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the multistep metastatic cascade, clinical detection methods, and clonal genetics of cancer dissemination.

topics.label: Lecture Summary and Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer provides concluding remarks, summarizes the convergence of cancer hallmarks, and references upcoming coursework.
